summary: A shopkeeper’s construction plan shows the old shop coming down a piece at a time.
realLife: Florence Dolan proposed building a larger store across the parcel from the existing one and dismantling the old building in sections as work progressed.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with shop, owner, site plan. A hearing question about the sequence can draw out which building occupies the site at each stage.

turns.what: A supplier asks which entrance to use during demolition.
turns.pulledBy: A delivery is scheduled while both building footprints are occupied.
turns.writesBack: The owner marks the loading entrance on the phasing plan.
